name: Kaunertaler Gletscherstraße
kurzbeschreibung: The Kaunertal Glacier Road is one of the Alps' premier high-altitude drives: 26 km, 29 hairpin turns, ascending from 1,287 m to 2,750 m past the turquoise Gepatsch Reservoir.
preis: Toll road applies vehicular fees; complimentary access for holders of valid glacier lift tickets
oeffnungszeiten: Open year-round weather permitting; winter tires mandatory in colder months
beschreibung:
Überblick

The exhilarating Kaunertal Glacier Road ranks among the most visually stunning high-alpine scenic highways in the European Alps. Covering 26 kilometres from the village of Feichten (1,287 m) up to the edge of the Weißseeferner ice field (2,750 m), this roadway ascends nearly 1,500 vertical metres. Travelers journey through distinct ecological life zones, traversing vibrant alpine hay meadows, subalpine larch forests, and lichen-covered boulders before terminating in a glaciated amphitheatre. Navigating 29 sweeping hairpin turns, the route delivers jaw-dropping alpine vistas at every bend. A centerpiece along the ascent is the six-kilometre-long Gepatsch Reservoir, whose emerald waters mirror surrounding granite crags. Over twenty educational viewpoints border the highway, interpreting local glaciology, mountain botany, and the pioneering engineering behind Austria's iconic rock-fill dam.

Route & Anforderungen

Driving or motorcycling the Kaunertal Glacier Road is an unforgettable alpine journey. The road is fully paved, double-laned, and maintained to the highest safety standards, featuring gradients between ten and twelve percent. Numerous signed pull-offs invite travelers to disembark for photo ops or short walks to glacial cascades and historic shepherd huts such as the Gepatschalm. Comfortable sneakers suffice for vehicle-based sightseeing; light hiking boots are advised for exploring moraine footpaths. Cyclists tackling the ascent should prepare for rapid weather shifts and crisp temperatures at 2,750 metres.

Besuch & Anreise

Motorists arrive via motorway A12 (exit Reschenpass) and follow highway B180 to Prutz, proceeding through the Kaunertal to the toll plaza just above Feichten. Expansive complimentary parking awaits at the glacier terminal. Public buses link Landeck train station with the glacier terminus throughout the summer.

Tipps

Stop at the historic Gepatschalm at 1,928 metres, the oldest operating alpine pasture hut in the valley, to sample artisanal Kaunertal alpine cheese. Pausing on the massive crest of the Gepatsch dam provides breathtaking photo opportunities.
